osm_tags.description: Though the ship is no longer around, the location of the wreck was documented as  47°40′43″S 75°02′57″W by survivors.
osm_tags.name: HMS Wager
osm_tags.note: A subsequent mutiny among the crew occured, which led the mutineers and captain being seperated; both returned to England in 1743 and 1744 respectively.
